title: 第10章 小没良心的

content_zh:
急匆匆跑下楼，还站在阶梯上就看到晨跑回来的一人一雪豹，下意识的就往后退。
慕非池扫了眼楼梯上的小木乃伊，朝她招了招手，“下来！”
军靴大踏步的踩在木质地板上，脚步铿锵。
相比起他的威武阳刚，他身边的雪豹就显得格外慵懒。
翘着个尾巴缓步走着，边走边盯着她看，不张牙舞爪的时候真像只大猫。
有这么只宠物在，云曦没敢动。
“它不咬人，你要不下来，那就让它上去请你。”
“别……我自己下来！”
与其被动，还不如自己主动。
从楼上下来，云曦警惕的看着朝自己靠近的雪豹，绷紧了神经挪不动脚了。
“它很喜欢你，不用担心会攻击你。”
雪豹在她脚边停了下来，挪着爪子在她脚背上拍了拍，仰着头卖萌。
见它真没有攻击自己的意思，她这才松了口气。
副官送了早餐过来，云曦看了眼桌子上简单的中式早餐，有些不可思议。
包子馒头豆浆清粥小菜，俨然是普通人家的早餐。
她还以为像慕非池这样身份尊贵的少帅，对吃食肯定挑剔呢！
上辈子，她看到的关于他的八卦，除了丰功伟绩之外，更多的还是娱乐媒体对他的追捧。
他是军中铁血的少帅，同样也是时尚界潮人。
只不过他私生活低调，越是低调越是有人不遗余力开扒他的绯闻。
这个被奉上神坛的男人，出色卓绝，可远观而不可近玩。

“吃完早餐副官会送你回去。”
“谢谢！”
云曦点点头，饿了一天前胸贴后背了，她也不跟他客气，直接坐了下来。
慕非池偏头看了眼那巴掌大素净的小脸，淡淡开口：“昨天晚上是你救了我。”
“不用道谢，我不欠人人情，咱们扯平了。”
平淡不谄媚的语气，看着不像是能从她这个年纪说出来的。
慕非池有些意外，幽沉的眸落在她纤细的手指上，掰着包子的手指节骨分明，丁点恩情瞥得干干净净。
他还是第一次看到有不愿意跟他扯上关系的女人。
虽然，还是个稚嫩的小丫头。
从昨晚醒来到现在，她似乎都没问过是谁替她换的衣服，睡在他床上她甚至没担心过自己的安危。
真不知道是心大还是少根筋。
“叫什么名字？”慕非池靠在椅背上，狭长的双眸微微眯起，定定的落在她脸上。
“云曦。云朵的云，晨曦的曦。”
云朵里的曦光，好名字。
云曦咽下嘴里的包子，喝完豆浆站起身。
“谢谢你的早餐，我要回去了！麻烦你让人送我出去吧！”
副官开车过来的时候，云曦换回了自己那套破烂的衣服，大白看她上车，飞跃着跑了过来，没等它蹿上车，云曦已经把车门关上了。
车窗外，大白趴在玻璃上，挪着爪子一脸不舍。
虽然知道它不咬人，云曦还是有些害怕，缩着脖子让齐原赶紧开车。
车子启动，齐原看了眼后视镜里依依不舍的一人一豹，淡淡开口：“没想到大白竟然喜欢你，除了少帅，它可是谁都不待见的！”

云曦别开头，看了眼后视镜里渐渐变小的一人一豹，面色平静。
今天以后，他们都不会再有牵扯，喜不喜欢对她来说并不重要。
站在原地，慕非池漫不经心的收回视线，薄唇轻扬：“小没良心的。”
连句再见也不说。

content_en:
I hurried downstairs, and while I was still standing on the stairs, I saw a snow leopard coming back from my morning run, and I subconsciously stepped back.
Mu Feichi glanced at the little mummy on the stairs and waved to her, "Come down!"
Military boots stepped on the wooden floor with loud steps.
Compared to his majesty and masculinity, the snow leopard next to him seems particularly lazy.
He walked slowly with his tail raised, staring at her as he walked. He really looked like a big cat when he wasn't showing his teeth and claws.
With such a pet around, Yun Xi didn't dare to move.
"It doesn't bite. If you don't want to come down, then let it go up and invite you."
"Don't... I'll come down by myself!"
Rather than being passive, it is better to be proactive.
Coming down from upstairs, Yun Xi looked at the snow leopard approaching her with vigilance, tensing up her nerves and unable to move her feet.
"It likes you very much. Don't worry about attacking you."
The snow leopard stopped at her feet, moved its paws and patted her instep, raising its head and looking cute.
Seeing that it really had no intention of attacking her, she breathed a sigh of relief.
The adjutant brought breakfast over, and Yun Xi looked at the simple Chinese breakfast on the table, a little surprised.
Steamed buns, soy milk, porridge and side dishes are just like breakfast for ordinary people.
She thought that a young marshal with such a distinguished status as Mu Feichi must be picky about food!
In her previous life, the gossip she had seen about him, in addition to his great achievements, was mostly about the entertainment media's pursuit of him.
He is a tough-blooded young marshal in the army, and he is also a trendy figure in the fashion industry.
It's just that his private life is low-key, and the more low-key he is, the more people go to great lengths to spread scandals about him.
This man who was enshrined on the altar was outstanding, but he could be seen from a distance but not played up close.
"The adjutant will take you back after breakfast."
"Thank you!"
Yun Xi nodded. After being hungry all day, her chest was pressed against her back. She didn't want to be polite to him and sat down directly.
Mu Feichi turned his head and glanced at the palm-sized, plain face, and said calmly: "You saved me last night."
"No need to thank you, I don't owe anyone any favors, we are even."
The tone was flat and unflattering, and it didn't seem like something she could say from someone her age.
Mu Feichi was a little surprised. His dark eyes fell on her slender fingers. The fingers holding the buns were clearly knuckled, and every trace of kindness could be seen clearly.
This was the first time he saw a woman who didn't want to have anything to do with him.
Although, she is still a young girl.
From the time she woke up last night until now, she didn't seem to have asked who changed her clothes, and she didn't even worry about her own safety while sleeping on his bed.
I really don’t know if it’s a big heart or a lack of strength.
"What's your name?" Mu Feichi leaned on the back of the chair, narrowed his eyes slightly, and focused on her face.
"Clouds. Clouds of clouds, dawn of dawn."
Sunlight in the clouds, a good name.
Yun Xi swallowed the buns in her mouth, drank the soy milk and stood up.
"Thank you for breakfast, I'm going back! Please ask someone to take me out!"
When the adjutant drove over, Yun Xi changed back into her tattered clothes. Dabai watched her get into the car and ran over in a leap. Before it could jump into the car, Yun Xi had already closed the car door.
Outside the car window, Dabai was lying on the glass, moving his paws with a look of reluctance.
Although she knew it didn't bite, Yun Xi was still a little scared, so she shrank her neck and asked Qi Yuan to drive quickly.
The car started, Qi Yuan glanced at the reluctant figures in the rearview mirror, and said calmly: "I didn't expect Dabai to like you. He doesn't want to see anyone except the young marshal!"
Yun Xi turned away and glanced at the person and the leopard in the rearview mirror, which were gradually getting smaller, with a calm expression.
After today, they will no longer be involved, and it doesn't matter to her whether she likes it or not.
Standing where he was, Mu Feichi looked away casually and raised his thin lips: "You little heartless one."
Not even a word of goodbye.
